silhouette.reason: Tilt-nacelle dropship with canopy, tail fin, gear legs and antennae; reads in every view.
fixes: a chin sensor blister so FRONT is less of a plain oval

proportions.reason: Nacelles, cabin and canopy are scaled for a 20 m craft; gear and windows at human scale.

materials.reason: The canopy speckle is gone (clean dark glass), a few darker access plates break the hull grey, and hazard and orange stripes separate; the dark scratch dashes are a uniform noise spread evenly over every plate.
fixes: concentrate the scratches on edges, hatches and walkways instead of an even dash noise
a slight roughness change between replacement panels and the base hull

detail.reason: Panel seams, louvres, vents, antennae, gear struts and markings hold at the hero distance.
fixes: rivet/fastener rows along the plate seams; hydraulic lines on the gear legs

wear.reason: Nacelle bellies are scorched brown, plates chipped and scratched; no oil streaks from the gear bays.
fixes: oil streaks from the gear bays
heat discolouration inside the nacelle mouths

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the nacelle hazard rings, the 07 and the canopy; with the camo gone the hull grey matches LOD0, so the switch is quiet.
fixes: keep the cabin window row at LOD2 (it thins out in the far view)

technical.reason: QA clean; 19k / 7k / 2k triangles, 15 draws for moving nacelles and gear.
fixes: split only faces taller than one strip band in the UV pass
